reason: Hired Claw can attack safely (Biotech's 1 power can't kill it); it adds one more Ingris ping and one more combat damage, and the opponent has little to swing back with.

11 power is attacking a player at 3 and three blockers can't stop lethal, with no tricks in hand; both blocks lose.

Six 1/1 Monks against an opponent at 5 with every creature tapped, no cards and no mana is lethal either way; Consult only adds overkill.
Opponent has an empty board and no cards in hand; Jace makes tokens and draws on each of their draw steps, while holding does nothing since the rest of the hand is sorceries.
Two lands that make both colors, cheap creatures and two 1-mana removal spells against aggro, in a 23-land deck: a standard keep on the play.
